newsitem.title: USA: Parker & Parsley completes Lopeno wells.
newsitem.headline: Parker & Parsley completes Lopeno wells.

text.p: Parker & Parsley Petroleum Co said Monday it has completed of three development wells in its South Texas Lopeno field located in Zapata County, Texas, which are now producing a total of 20 million cubic feet of natural gas per day.
Each well is producing from four sands in the Wilcox formation between 8,700 feet and 11,200 feet with over 4,500 pounds of flowing tubing pressure.
Parker & Parsley and Pogo Producing Co each own a 50 percent working interest in the Lopeno field.

As a result of this successful development, along with a recently completed 3-D seismic survey, Parker & Parsley has identified at least six additional locations which it anticipates drilling in 1997, the company said. It expects these new locations will initially produce three to seven million cubic feet of natural gas per day per well.
